newsitem.title: CHINA: China names Liao Hui as top official on HK affairs.
newsitem.headline: China names Liao Hui as top official on HK affairs.

text.p: China has named a man who supervised Beijing's overseas Chinese affairs for more than a decade as its top official on Hong Kong affairs, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The State Council, or cabinet, appointed Liao Hui, 55, as director of its Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office, Xinhua said.
Liao replaces Lu Ping, who had been in office since 1990.
Liao was director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office for 13 years and sat on the committee that drafted Hong Kong's mini-constitution.

Earlier this month China appointed Jiang Enzhu, a former Chinese ambassador to London, as director of the Hong Kong branch of Xinhua, making him Beijing's top envoy in the former British colony, which reverted to Chinese rule on July 1.
